scope: Verified only the PDF JPX permissions, prohibitions and image-dictionary contracts against the local ISO_32000-2_sponsored_EC3.txt (ISO 32000-2:2020 with Errata Collection 3), clause 7.4.9 and clause 8.9.5 Table 87 (Width, Height, ColorSpace, BitsPerComponent, ImageMask, Decode, SMask, SMaskInData). tables: 87: Width, Height, ColorSpace, BitsPerComponent, ImageMask, Decode, SMask, SMaskInData
requirements.status: PDF text verified; dictionary enforcement is partly outside this codec API

pdf_review.rule: JPX is for image XObjects with matching dimensions; dictionary colour overrides embedded colour; dictionary bit depth is ignored; absent dictionary colour suppresses Decode except for a one-channel one-bit stencil; nonzero SMaskInData selects embedded opacity, excludes SMask and requires one alpha for all colours.
pdf_review.verdict: partial implementation: dispatch checks dimensions, ordinary component count, ignores dictionary BitsPerComponent, drops Decode when required and rejects simultaneous SMask/nonzero SMaskInData; embedded alpha values 1/2, colour negotiation/CMYK and full-file enforcement remain caller gaps.
pdf_review.implementation_expectations: Codec vectors exercise colour metadata and a supported/unsupported bit-depth boundary; no PDF dictionary fixture is claimed because these paths belong to the image facade.
pdf_review.documented_choice: Raw codestream input remains a standalone codec convenience, not evidence that a bare codestream meets the PDF full-JPX-file rule; ICC bytes are preserved without declaring profile conformance.
pdf_review.locator_verdict: verified against the stated local PDF text; codec algorithms are not thereby verified

verified_locators: 8.9.5, Table 87: Width, Height, ColorSpace, BitsPerComponent, ImageMask, Decode, SMask, SMaskInData

differential_evidence.results: All reversible source-pixel comparisons exact; irreversible differences at most 2, within per-vector tolerances 1 or 3. ICC and channel/CMYK metadata assertions are separate from colour-managed output comparisons.
choices_and_gaps: Raw codestream support is a standalone convenience; the PDF full-file rule must be enforced by the image facade.
No claim that PDF text specifies T.800 marker, entropy-coding, wavelet or box mechanics.
T.800-dependent strict corruption errors, progression collection and packed-header fragment handling remain pending primary-text review.
Predictable-termination codewords decode in the differential vectors; termination integrity validation is not implemented and awaits T.800 primary-text review.
Floating-point irreversible rounding is tolerance-tested, not claimed bit-exact.
